tasks.description: Optimize frontend code to reduce load times and improve responsiveness. Focus on reducing unnecessary HTTP requests and minifying CSS/JS files. Use tools like Webpack and Babel to optimize code.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user navigates to the homepage, when the page loads, then the load time is under 2 seconds

tasks.description: Implement caching mechanisms on the backend to reduce database queries and improve response times. Use a caching library like Redis or Memcached to store frequently accessed data.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user makes a repeated request, when the cache is enabled, then the response time is reduced by 50%

tasks.description: Optimize database indexes to improve query performance. Analyze query patterns and create indexes on frequently accessed columns.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user runs a query, when the index is applied, then the query time is reduced by 30%

tasks.description: Develop a dashboard to track and visualize performance metrics such as load times, response times, and error rates. Use a monitoring tool like New Relic or Datadog to collect data.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user views the dashboard, when the data is updated, then the metrics are accurately displayed

tasks.description: Develop automated testing scripts to simulate user interactions and measure performance. Use a testing framework like Selenium or Cypress to write tests.
acceptance_criteria: Given a test is run, when the script completes, then the performance metrics are collected and reported

tasks.description: Identify and fix known performance bottlenecks in the application. Use profiling tools to identify areas of slow code and optimize them.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user interacts with the application, when the bottleneck is fixed, then the performance is improved

tasks.description: Establish a code review process to ensure that all code changes are reviewed for performance impact. Use a code review tool like GitHub Code Review to facilitate the process.
acceptance_criteria: Given a code change is submitted, when the review is completed, then the performance impact is assessed and addressed
